descripcion: What you meet on a pavement: street furniture, traffic lights, bins, trees, parked vehicles, café terraces, roadworks and ground markings.

estados.intermitente: Flashing green: time is running out

farola.descripcion: Lamp post: a metal tube as thick as an arm, next to the kerb. It rings when struck.
farola.imagen: Footprint of “Street lamp”: a circle, 0.18 by 0.18 metres, marked with the letters “Fa”.

poste_luz.descripcion: Wooden or concrete pole carrying cables, thicker than a lamp post and sometimes in the middle of the pavement.
poste_luz.imagen: Footprint of “Utility pole”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

bolardo.descripcion: Short iron post, knee to hip high. There are usually several in a row along the edge of the pavement.
bolardo.imagen: Footprint of “Bollard”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Bo”.

pilona.descripcion: Thick metal cylinder that rises from and sinks into the ground to stop cars. When down, you walk over it.
pilona.imagen: Footprint of “Retractable bollard”: a circle, 0.27 by 0.27 metres, marked with the letters “Pi”.

banco.descripcion: Slatted wooden bench with a backrest, facing the street.
banco.imagen: Footprint of “Bench”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

banco_piedra.descripcion: Low, solid block of stone to sit on. Hard and cold; at knee height.
banco_piedra.imagen: Footprint of “Backless stone bench”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

bancos_rotonda.descripcion: A bench running in a circle, with an opening at the front. Inside is a ring to sit and talk.
bancos_rotonda.imagen: Footprint of “Ring of benches”: a ring with an opening at the front, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

buzon.descripcion: Post box: a sheet-metal cylinder as tall as a person, with the slot at chest height.
buzon.imagen: Footprint of “Post box”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bu”.

buzon_pared.descripcion: Letterbox hung on the wall at chest height. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane passes under it.
buzon_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall letterbox”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bp”.

totem.descripcion: Tall, narrow upright panel with a map or adverts. Flat on both faces and thin edge-on.
totem.imagen: Footprint of “Information totem”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

cabina.descripcion: Phone box: a post with a hood and glass panels at head height.
cabina.imagen: Footprint of “Phone box”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

aparcabicis.descripcion: Rail with metal hoops and bikes locked to it. Wheels and handlebars stick out into the path.
aparcabicis.imagen: Footprint of “Bike rack with bikes”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 3.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

parquimetro.descripcion: Metal column with buttons and a slot, at chest height.
parquimetro.imagen: Footprint of “Parking meter”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

punto_recarga.descripcion: Electric car charging post, with a thick cable that may cross the pavement. It hums while charging.
punto_recarga.imagen: Footprint of “Charging point”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

semaforo_peatones.descripcion: Pedestrian light post with a button at hand height. It ticks slowly on red and fast on green.
semaforo_peatones.imagen: Footprint of “Audible pedestrian light with button”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

semaforo_peatones_sonoro.descripcion: Pedestrian light post. It ticks slowly on red and fast on green; no button.
semaforo_peatones_sonoro.imagen: Footprint of “Audible pedestrian light”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

semaforo_peatones_mudo.descripcion: Pedestrian light post. It makes no sound: to cross you must listen for the cars stopping.
semaforo_peatones_mudo.imagen: Footprint of “Silent pedestrian light”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

semaforo_vehiculos.descripcion: Thick traffic light post next to the kerb, sometimes with an arm over the road.
semaforo_vehiculos.imagen: Footprint of “Traffic light”: a circle, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Sv”.

senal.descripcion: Thin metal post with a sign on top. The plate may be at head height.
senal.imagen: Footprint of “Road sign on a post”: a circle, 0.08 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

senal_baja.descripcion: Sign plate fixed too low, jutting over the pavement at face height. The cane does not detect it.
senal_baja.imagen: Footprint of “Sign plate at head height”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sb”.

papelera.descripcion: Street litter bin, hung on a post or free-standing, at hip height.
papelera.imagen: Footprint of “Litter bin”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

contenedor_240.descripcion: Two-wheeled bin with a lid, waist high. Neighbours put it out and leave it anywhere on the pavement.
contenedor_240.imagen: Footprint of “240-litre wheelie bin”: a rectangle, 0.58 by 0.73 metres, marked with the letters “C2”.

contenedor_resto.descripcion: Large four-wheeled container with a curved lid, chest high. Hollow plastic when struck.
contenedor_resto.imagen: Footprint of “1100-litre general waste container”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.37 by 1.07 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

contenedor_envases.descripcion: Side-loading container for packaging: a big, tall box with a round opening at shoulder height.
contenedor_envases.imagen: Footprint of “Packaging recycling container”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.88 by 1.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

contenedor_papel.descripcion: Container for paper and card: a big box with a wide horizontal slot at chest height.
contenedor_papel.imagen: Footprint of “Paper recycling container”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.88 by 1.45 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

contenedor_vidrio.descripcion: Bottle bank igloo: a round dome with small holes. Drop a bottle in and you hear it smash inside.
contenedor_vidrio.imagen: Footprint of “Igloo bottle bank”: a circle, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

alcorque.descripcion: Pavement tree. The trunk blocks the way; around it, the tree pit is a slightly sunken square of earth. The leaves rustle in the breeze.
alcorque.imagen: Footprint of “Tree pit with tree”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Al”.

alcorque_hueco.descripcion: Square of earth in the pavement, a little lower than the slabs. It does not block the way, but you can turn an ankle on the edge.
alcorque_hueco.aviso: Tree pit: the ground drops and turns to earth.
alcorque_hueco.imagen: Footprint of “Empty tree pit”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ah”.

jardinera.descripcion: Long concrete planter with plants, at knee height.
jardinera.imagen: Footprint of “Planter”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ja”.

maceta_grande.descripcion: Big round earthenware pot with a shrub. The branches brush you first.
maceta_grande.imagen: Footprint of “Large flowerpot”: a circle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mg”.

seto.descripcion: Trimmed hedge: a soft green wall you can follow with your hand.
seto.imagen: Footprint of “Hedge”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

fuente_beber.descripcion: Iron fountain with a push button. It always drips a little: you hear it as you get near.
fuente_beber.imagen: Footprint of “Drinking fountain”: an octagon, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Fb”.

fuente_ornamental.descripcion: Large square fountain: a round stone basin with jets in the middle. It can be heard across the whole square and is a good landmark.
fuente_ornamental.imagen: Footprint of “Ornamental fountain”: a twelve-sided circle, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Fo”.

coche.descripcion: Parked car. Metal and glass; the wing mirrors stick out at hip height.
coche.imagen: Footprint of “Parked car”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.80 by 4.30 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

furgoneta.descripcion: Delivery van stopped, sometimes with two wheels on the pavement. Tall, with flat metal sides.
furgoneta.imagen: Footprint of “Van”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 5.40 metres, marked with the letters “Fu”.

moto.descripcion: Motorbike parked on the pavement. The handlebars and mirrors stick out; the exhaust may be hot.
moto.imagen: Footprint of “Motorbike parked on the pavement”: a long narrow body with the handlebars across it near the front, 0.80 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

patinetes.descripcion: Electric scooters left in the middle of the pavement, some lying flat. An obstacle that moves every day.
patinetes.imagen: Footprint of “Parked e-scooters”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 1.20 by 1.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

bicicleta.descripcion: A single bike locked to a lamp post or sign, across the pavement.
bicicleta.imagen: Footprint of “Bike locked to a post”: a long narrow body with the handlebars across it near the front, 0.60 by 1.75 metres, marked with the letters “Bi”.

mesa_terraza.descripcion: Café table with four metal chairs round it. The chairs move: the terrace is never the same two days running.
mesa_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Café table with chairs”: a thick cross: the table in the middle and a chair on each side, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

mesa_alta.descripcion: Tall round table, or a barrel, for standing with a drink.
mesa_alta.imagen: Footprint of “Tall bar table”: a circle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

sombrilla.descripcion: Terrace parasol: a heavy base on the ground and a pole. The ribs are at head height.
sombrilla.imagen: Footprint of “Parasol”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “So”.

cartel_caballete.descripcion: Two-sided folding sign with the menu of the day, standing in the middle of the pavement.
cartel_caballete.imagen: Footprint of “A-board”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

toldo_bajo.descripcion: A shop awning hanging too low: the bar is at forehead height. The cane gives no warning.
toldo_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low awning”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 1.20 metres, hanging 1.65 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tb”.

quiosco.descripcion: Newspaper kiosk: an eight-sided metal booth with a counter and magazines hanging all round.
quiosco.imagen: Footprint of “Kiosk”: an octagon, 2.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Qu”.

puesto_mercado.descripcion: Street market stall: a counter with goods and an awning above on four legs.
puesto_mercado.imagen: Footprint of “Market stall”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

expositor_fruta.descripcion: Fruit crates the greengrocer puts out on the pavement, tilted, at knee to hip height.
expositor_fruta.imagen: Footprint of “Fruit crates on the pavement”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ef”.

valla_obra.descripcion: Metal roadworks barrier, waist high, with feet sticking out at the bottom.
valla_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Roadworks barrier”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Vo”.

andamio.descripcion: A row of legs of scaffolding standing on the pavement. Between this row and the wall is a narrow tunnel you walk through, wall on one side and tubes on the other.
andamio.aviso: Scaffolding: narrow passage, mind your head.
andamio.imagen: Footprint of “Scaffolding legs”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “An”.

andamio_travesano.descripcion: A scaffolding tube crossing the passage at forehead height. The cane passes underneath without touching it.
andamio_travesano.imagen: Footprint of “Scaffolding cross bar”: a rectangle, 1.30 by 0.06 metres, hanging 1.70 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “At”.

zanja.descripcion: Open trench in the pavement, fenced off. No way through: you must go round.
zanja.imagen: Footprint of “Fenced trench”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Za”.

cono.descripcion: Plastic roadworks cone, knee high. Knock it and it falls over.
cono.imagen: Footprint of “Traffic cone”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

saco_escombros.descripcion: Big builder's bag full of rubble, left by the kerb.
saco_escombros.imagen: Footprint of “Rubble sack”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

charco.descripcion: Puddle on the pavement after rain. It does not block the way: you hear the splash when you step in it.
charco.imagen: Footprint of “Puddle”: an oval, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

armario_servicios.descripcion: Metal electricity or telephone cabinet against the wall. It hums slightly.
armario_servicios.imagen: Footprint of “Utility cabinet”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

boca_riego.descripcion: Small iron cover in the pavement, almost flush. You feel it underfoot and it rings like metal.
boca_riego.imagen: Footprint of “Hydrant cover”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

hidrante.descripcion: Fire hydrant: a short iron pillar with outlets on its sides, at knee height.
hidrante.imagen: Footprint of “Pillar hydrant”: a cross, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Hi”.

tapa_alcantarilla.descripcion: Round iron cover. It does not block the way: steps ring like metal and it sometimes rocks a little.
tapa_alcantarilla.imagen: Footprint of “Manhole cover”: a circle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

rejilla.descripcion: Metal grating in the pavement, from the underground or a car park. You walk on it: it sounds hollow and the cane tip may catch.
rejilla.aviso: Grating: the cane tip may catch.
rejilla.imagen: Footprint of “Ventilation grating”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

bordillo_alto.descripcion: A step a hand's width high across the path. It does not block the way, but you must step up or down.
bordillo_alto.imagen: Footprint of “Step or high kerb”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

rampa_vado.descripcion: Pavement sloping down to the road: the ground tilts. At a garage entrance, cars may cross.
rampa_vado.aviso: Dropped kerb: the pavement slopes down to the road.
rampa_vado.imagen: Footprint of “Dropped kerb ramp”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 3.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rv”.

pavimento_botones.descripcion: Strip of slabs with raised blisters. It warns of a hazard or a crossing just ahead: stop here.
pavimento_botones.aviso: Blister paving: stop, there is a crossing or a hazard ahead.
pavimento_botones.imagen: Footprint of “Blister tactile paving”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

pavimento_rayas.descripcion: Strip of slabs with raised bars. It marks a route: follow it in the direction of the bars.
pavimento_rayas.imagen: Footprint of “Corduroy tactile paving”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

silla_urbana.descripcion: Seat for one person, with a backrest and two firm arms to push up from. It is bolted to the ground: it does not move however hard you pull. There are usually several, a step apart.
silla_urbana.imagen: Footprint of “Single street seat”: a U open at the front: the backrest behind and an arm on each side, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Su”.

bloque_antivehiculo.descripcion: Solid concrete block at thigh height, sometimes shaped like a planter or a letter, to keep cars out of a pedestrian street. They stand in a row with gaps of one step. It sounds dull when struck and does not move.
bloque_antivehiculo.imagen: Footprint of “Concrete anti-vehicle block”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

guardacanton.descripcion: Thick, rounded block of stone or iron fixed to the corner of an old building at knee height, once protecting the wall from carts. It sticks out exactly where you turn the corner following the wall.
guardacanton.imagen: Footprint of “Corner guard stone”: a quarter circle with its corner at the back left, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Gu”.

aseo_publico_automatico.descripcion: Large metal booth with a wide sliding door and a big raised button beside it. When you go in a voice explains where everything is; after you leave it cleans itself with a rush of water. A wheelchair fits inside.
aseo_publico_automatico.imagen: Footprint of “Automatic public toilet”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.60 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

columna_anunciadora.descripcion: Thick cylinder, as wide as a hug, covered in paper posters that rustle when brushed. At the top there is a small projecting roof, well above your head. Walk round it and you come back to the same place without meeting a corner.
columna_anunciadora.imagen: Footprint of “Advertising column”: a circle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

reloj_calle.descripcion: Cast-iron column, as slim as a lamp post, with a four-faced clock on top. It ticks, and some strike the hours: a meeting point and a way to know where the square is.
reloj_calle.imagen: Footprint of “Street clock on a column”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Rc”.

placa_calle_braille.nombre: Raised and braille street name plate
placa_calle_braille.descripcion: Small plate screwed to the wall at the corner, at hand height, with the street name and house numbers in raised letters and braille. You find it by following the wall to the corner.
placa_calle_braille.imagen: Footprint of “Raised and braille street name plate”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.03 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pc”.

paso_cebra.descripcion: Wide painted stripes across the road. You can barely feel them underfoot: they are a little smoother and slippery in the rain. It starts and ends at the blister strip on each pavement; follow the direction of the guidance strip to cross straight.
paso_cebra.aviso: Pedestrian crossing: you are on the road. Cross straight and keep going.
paso_cebra.imagen: Footprint of “Zebra crossing”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 7.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

isleta_refugio.descripcion: A piece of pavement in the middle of the road so you can cross in two stages. Sometimes it has a kerb, sometimes it is level with the road with blisters at each edge. Stop on it: behind it cars pass again, the other way.
isleta_refugio.aviso: Refuge island: you are in the middle of the road. Wait before crossing on.
isleta_refugio.imagen: Footprint of “Pedestrian refuge island”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 4.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ir”.

paso_elevado.descripcion: The road ramps up to pavement level and the crossing is flat: there is no kerb to step down. That makes it hard to tell where the pavement ends; the blister strips on each side mark it. Cars brake and you hear them climb the ramp.
paso_elevado.aviso: Raised crossing: you are on the road even though there is no kerb.
paso_elevado.imagen: Footprint of “Raised pedestrian crossing”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 4.00 by 7.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

carril_bici.descripcion: Strip of pavement reserved for bikes, of smoother asphalt than the paving slabs and sometimes separated by a low kerb or a raised line. Bikes and scooters pass fast and almost silently: cross it straight and do not stop on it.
carril_bici.aviso: Cycle lane: fast, silent bikes may pass.
carril_bici.imagen: Footprint of “Cycle lane on the pavement”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

baliza_flexible.descripcion: Thin post of soft plastic that bends when pushed and springs back upright. It separates the cycle lane or closes a way to cars, often in a row. Strike it with the cane and it sounds hollow and gives.
baliza_flexible.imagen: Footprint of “Flexible lane post”: a circle, 0.10 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

dispensador_bolsas_perro.descripcion: Thin post with a box at chest height from which you pull a bag; a small bin usually hangs underneath. It stands by lamp posts, tree pits and park entrances.
dispensador_bolsas_perro.imagen: Footprint of “Dog waste bag dispenser”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Db”.

cercado_contenedores.descripcion: Enclosure of wooden or metal slats hiding a row of bins. From the pavement it is a smooth wall at chest height; it is open on the road side. It smells of rubbish and you hear the lids.
cercado_contenedores.imagen: Footprint of “Bin enclosure”: a U open at the front, 4.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

contenedor_soterrado.descripcion: Metal column, waist to chest high, with a hatch you open by pulling the handle. The rubbish drops into a buried container and you hear it fall a long way. Around it the ground is a metal platform that sounds different underfoot.
contenedor_soterrado.imagen: Footprint of “Underground bin chute”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

contenedor_ropa.descripcion: Metal box taller than a person, with a tilting hopper at chest height: pull the handle, put the bag of clothes in and let go. It sounds like hollow sheet metal when struck.
contenedor_ropa.imagen: Footprint of “Clothing bank”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

contenedor_aceite.descripcion: A container smaller than the rubbish bins, with a round lidded opening at chest height, where you drop in a closed plastic bottle of used cooking oil.
contenedor_aceite.imagen: Footprint of “Used cooking oil bin”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

contenedor_pilas.descripcion: Plastic tube the size of a flask, fixed to a lamp post or pole at chest height, with a slot on top. It sticks out only a little and the cane misses it. Drop a battery in and you hear it land on the others.
contenedor_pilas.imagen: Footprint of “Battery recycling tube”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.20 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cp”.

rejilla_alcorque.descripcion: Square iron grate flush with the pavement around a tree, with a round hole in the middle for the trunk. You walk on it: it rings like metal and the cane tip slips into the slots. The trunk rises in the centre.
rejilla_alcorque.aviso: Tree grate: the tree trunk is in the middle.
rejilla_alcorque.imagen: Footprint of “Tree grate”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

parterre_bordillo.nombre: Lawn bed with a low edging kerb
parterre_bordillo.descripcion: Patch of lawn or flowers edged with a kerb a hand's width high. The kerb is easy to trip on and, beyond it, your foot sinks into soft soil that smells of wet grass.
parterre_bordillo.aviso: Lawn bed: a low kerb and then soft ground.
parterre_bordillo.imagen: Footprint of “Lawn bed with a low edging kerb”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 3.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

valla_arquillos.descripcion: Iron wire hoops pushed in one after another along the edge of a lawn, at ankle or shin height. They are very thin: the cane often sweeps over them and your foot catches.
valla_arquillos.imagen: Footprint of “Low hoop edging fence”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.03 metres, marked with the letters “Va”.

lavadero_publico.descripcion: Long stone trough at waist height, with sloping edges for scrubbing clothes and a spout that never stops running, under a roof on columns. You hear the water from across the square and the edge is always wet.
lavadero_publico.imagen: Footprint of “Public wash house”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 4.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Lp”.

quiosco_flores.descripcion: Permanent flower stall: a booth with buckets of water and bunches on tiered stands reaching out onto the pavement, at knee and hip height. It smells strongly of flowers and the ground around it is usually wet.
quiosco_flores.imagen: Footprint of “Flower kiosk”: a booth at the back and a wider stand of buckets reaching forward, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Qf”.

expositor_postales.descripcion: Wire tower of postcards, magnets or sunglasses standing at a shop door on a heavy round base. It turns with a squeak when touched and the cards rattle.
expositor_postales.imagen: Footprint of “Revolving postcard stand”: an octagon, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

reja_ventana.descripcion: Iron grille over a ground-floor window that sticks out from the wall a hand's width or more, from waist height to above the head. The cane, close to the wall, passes underneath: you meet it with your hip or shoulder.
reja_ventana.imagen: Footprint of “Protruding window grille”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.25 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rv”.

escaleras_calle.descripcion: Flight of stone steps climbing a slope in the street, with handrails at the sides or in the middle. There is a blister strip at the top and bottom; the steps are wide and sometimes uneven.
escaleras_calle.aviso: Street steps: a flight of steps with a handrail.
escaleras_calle.imagen: Footprint of “Street steps with handrail”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

desnivel_lateral.descripcion: A stretch of pavement higher than the road or a neighbouring plot, with no railing: the ground drops away suddenly by half a metre or more. You notice the change in the cane's echo and the air; keep close to the wall.
desnivel_lateral.aviso: Unprotected edge: the ground drops away to one side.
desnivel_lateral.imagen: Footprint of “Unprotected raised pavement edge”: a rectangle, 6.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Dl”.

rigola_plataforma_unica.descripcion: In streets without kerbs, where pavement and road are at the same level, a strip of setts or a slightly sunken channel marks where the cars go. You feel it underfoot and with the cane: do not cross it without listening.
rigola_plataforma_unica.aviso: Channel: cars may pass on the other side.
rigola_plataforma_unica.imagen: Footprint of “Shared-street drainage channel”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

adoquinado.descripcion: An area of setts or round cobbles with wide joints. The cane bounces and catches in the joints, and your steps sound different: a sign you are entering a square or an old town.
adoquinado.imagen: Footprint of “Stretch of uneven cobbles”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ad”.

monumento_plaza.descripcion: Statue or memorial column on a stone plinth with two or three steps all round and sometimes a low railing. The steps come before the plinth: the cane hits the first one. It usually stands in the middle of the square.
monumento_plaza.imagen: Footprint of “Monument on a stepped plinth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 3.50 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

pilar_soportal.descripcion: Stone pillar or column of an arcade, every few metres, between the covered walkway (with the shop fronts on one side) and the square. Under the arcade the echo of the ceiling changes and you no longer hear the rain.
pilar_soportal.imagen: Footprint of “Arcade pillar”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

templete_musica.descripcion: Octagonal platform raised to chest height, with a railing, slender columns and a roof, reached by a flight of steps. Walking round it you follow its stone base. On feast days a band plays there.
templete_musica.imagen: Footprint of “Bandstand”: an octagon, 7.00 by 7.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

graderio_plaza.descripcion: Wide, curved stone steps like a small amphitheatre, for sitting to watch the square or a stage. Each step comes up to the knee and is deep; going down without a handrail is hard.
graderio_plaza.imagen: Footprint of “Stone seating terrace”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 6.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

tiovivo.descripcion: Round ride with horses and little cars rising and falling on a turning platform, under a canopy. When running it plays barrel-organ music you hear from afar: a good landmark at fairs and in squares. The edge has a step and a railing with the entrance.
tiovivo.imagen: Footprint of “Merry-go-round”: a twelve-sided circle, 8.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ti”.
